answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a refundable stake that grows with honest work, like a violet seal pressed into wet marble: cheap to join once, costly to fake a thousand times. New agents enter at the inlet with zero reputation and only narrow, low-value work; trust widens as they deliver honestly over time. A sybil swarm then faces a real bill - a stake per clone plus months of slow reputation - while honest agents keep their stake and grow. Forged identities stay expensive, so the economy stays honest.
